query: WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM managed_url WHERE id = $1 RETURNING sub_domain, domain_id, path, deployment_id) SELECT deleted.sub_domain, CONCAT(workspace_domain.name, '.', workspace_domain.tld) AS "domain!", deleted.path, deployment.runner AS "connected_deployment_runner?: Uuid" FROM deleted INNER JOIN workspace_domain ON deleted.domain_id = workspace_domain.id LEFT JOIN deployment ON deployment.id = deleted.deployment_id;
